scripts.dev:run: pnpm run db:generate && pnpm run db:deploy && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" build && pnpm -r --parallel --filter "./apps/**" dev
scripts.build: pnpm run db:generate && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" build && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/**" build
scripts.build:workers: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" build && pnpm --filter @b2b/storefront run build:worker && pnpm --filter @b2b/admin run build:worker
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run db:generate && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" build && pnpm -r typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run db:generate && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/**" build && pnpm -r test
